claim_under_test: Current aggregate zeta zero-density and zero-free inputs, together with standard functional-equation and conjugation symmetry but without an additional pointwise exceptional-zero theorem, are sufficient by themselves to supply the missing all-index sign/tail bridge needed to promote the Bombieri-Lagarias/Li explicit-formula representation to lambda_n >= 0 for every n.
scope_guard: This tests sufficiency of the aggregate inputs alone, not every possible future use of zero-density estimates inside a stronger zeta-specific argument.
No synthetic zero multiset is asserted to be the actual zeta zero set.
No numerical verification can carry theorem authority.

falsifier_spec.construction: Plant one off-critical quartet closed under rho -> conjugate(rho) and rho -> 1-rho: {3/4+iT, 3/4-iT, 1/4+iT, 1/4-iT}, with T sufficiently large.
checks: Verify that the current explicit zero-free region near sigma=1 does not exclude beta=3/4 for the chosen large T.
Verify that a zero-density upper bound of positive power size does not force the exceptional count to be zero and therefore is logically compatible with one planted quartet.
For rho_L=1/4+iT, evaluate |1-1/rho_L|^2 exactly and determine whether it exceeds 1.
Use the exact Li zero-transform sensitivity and the Voros non-RH growth dichotomy only as source-bound interpretation; do not infer that the quartet occurs for zeta.
falsifier_spec.pass_condition: The aggregate hypotheses themselves imply an exact mechanism that excludes or sign-neutralizes the planted quartet uniformly for every Li index n.
falsifier_spec.fail_condition: The aggregate hypotheses permit the planted quartet while its left partner has |1-1/rho|>1, leaving the all-n Li sign bridge uncontrolled.
